Tasks: 188 SWE-NFI tasks; same input to all agents (task description + code_before; code_after hidden). Configurations: 2 commercial agents with their own models, 2 open-source agents x 3 backbone models (8). Baseline: Human Reference (merged PR revision); open-source agents share models to isolate the model. Held constant: task input, evaluation suite; temperature 0 where supported. Acceptance: task-specific functional preservation checks, then rule-based NFI scoring. Repetitions: 5 per configuration and task, mean and sd reported; no statistical tests. Human intervention: none

Highest FPC rate 70.0% (Claude Code); mini-SWE-agent configurations pass checks on only 4.8-11.5% of valid outputs. All configurations below the Human Reference on Logic Patterns (0.0-1.3 vs 1.5); several exceed it on Documentation (Aider + GPT-4.1 8.1 vs 8.0), Error Handling, Library Constraints or Coding Style. Multi-file tasks reduce Error Handling (up to 1.7 pp) and Logic Patterns (up to 1.1 pp) improvements; two mini-SWE configurations have no eligible multi-file outputs. Aggregate NFI stable across runs (sd 0.1-0.4 for Codex, Claude Code, Aider). Claude Code uses ~100x the tokens of Codex for +5.2 pp FPC; cost per successful task 120.02 s / 424,970 tokens vs Codex 21.08 s / 4,339. Differences are descriptive (no significance testing)

Distinguished configurations on FPC rate, aspect-level NFI and cost; repeatable across five runs (low sd). Limitations stated: rules equally weighted and thresholds partly operational choices, so scores reflect the rule set only; Python only; uneven task distribution across aspects and scopes (one multi-file Logic Patterns task); manual construction steps may introduce subjectivity

Rule set cannot capture all software quality; threshold checks may miss or penalise contextually appropriate code; Python only; sparse subsets to be read with caution; stochastic agents (mitigated by 5 runs). Gaps: non-functional improvement as a distinct agent capability; logic-pattern improvement and multi-file coordination; extend to other languages and underrepresented categories; rules as feedback signals for NFI-aware agents
